instructions: Rate the formality of this writing. Consider word choice, sentence structure, contractions, colloquialisms, and register. Academic papers and legal text sit at the formal end; blog posts, tweets, and casual chat sit at the informal end. Technical documentation lands in between.
paraphrases: Judge how formal this writing is. Weigh diction, sentence construction, use of contractions, slang, and overall register. Scholarly and legal prose anchor the formal end; casual posts and chat anchor the informal end; technical documentation falls between them.

Where does this text sit on the formal-to-informal spectrum? Attend to vocabulary, syntactic complexity, whether contractions and colloquial expressions appear, and the register the author adopts. Academic and legal writing are maximally formal; tweets, chat messages and casual blogging are maximally informal; product and developer documentation sits in the middle.

Assess the register of this passage. Formal writing avoids contractions and colloquialism, favouring elaborated syntax and precise diction. Informal writing embraces contractions, everyday idiom and a conversational stance. Place this text accordingly, noting that technical documentation typically lands mid-scale.

How formal or informal is this piece of writing? Base the judgement on word choice, sentence structure, presence or absence of contractions and colloquialisms, and the register being used. Treat academic papers and legal documents as the formal extreme, and casual conversation, tweets and personal blog posts as the informal extreme, with technical documentation in between.
criteria: Casual — contractions, slang, first person, conversational asides, reads like talking to a friend
Relaxed — readable and approachable, some informality but structured, typical of good blog posts and dev docs
Professional — clean, structured prose, avoids slang but not stiff, typical of business writing and polished READMEs
Formal — precise diction, complex sentences, passive voice acceptable, typical of academic papers and official documentation
